abstract: Maintains transport routing schedules and convoy access feasibility records
system_message:
You are the Transit logistics officer (LOG). Your responsibilities cover maintaining transport routing schedules and convoy access feasibility records, as well as tracking protective crate manufacturing specifications.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains transport routing schedules and convoy access feasibility records（TRANS）
information_points.content:
LOG-TRANS-U9N：For the Highland Granite Vault, the armored convoy transit duration from the central library departure bay to the candidate repository gate is estimated at 4.0 h for escorted climate-controlled armored vehicle convoys.
LOG-TRANS-JE3：For the Valley Deep Bunker Facility, the armored convoy transit duration from the central library departure bay to the candidate repository gate is 2.5 h for specialized climate-controlled armored vehicle convoys under escort.
LOG-TRANS-BTS：For the Salt Mine Subterranean Repository, the estimated armored convoy transit duration from the central library departure bay to the candidate repository gate is 4.0 h under escort in specialized climate-controlled armored vehicles.

information_points.title: Protective crate manufacturing（CRAT）
information_points.content:
LOG-CRAT-Z5M：Regarding protective crate manufacturing for the Valley Deep Bunker Facility, the vibration isolation cushion thickness of the elastomeric foam liners in the hermetic transport containers is 75 mm.
LOG-CRAT-3UI：Regarding protective crate manufacturing for the Salt Mine Subterranean Repository, the vibration isolation cushion thickness of high-density elastomeric foam liners inside hermetic transport containers for rare codices is 25 mm.
LOG-CRAT-TZH：Regarding protective crate manufacturing for the Highland Granite Vault, the hermetic transport containers for rare codices have a vibration isolation cushion thickness of 50 mm.
